rows.explanation: The patient has Hashimoto thyroiditis managed with levothyroxine replacement and gout, which indicates replacement therapy rather than systemic immunosuppressive treatment. There is evidence of a prednisone taper completed in April 2025, which is more than 2 years before the planned study treatment start on 2026-06-22, so it falls outside the 2-year window. There is also very recent prednisone use for 5 days in June 2026, but short-course corticosteroids for less than 5 days are typically not considered systemic treatment for autoimmune disease exclusion purposes, and no new active autoimmune disease requiring systemic treatment is documented within the past 2 years. Therefore, no active autoimmune disease treated systemically in the past 2 years is documented that would exclude the patient.
